info.title: UEY Premium Mobility API
info.description: Complete backend API documentation for UEY Premium Mobility ride-hailing platform.

get.description: Retrieves history logs of all administrative actions, supporting filter parameters.
Retrieves details of a specific administrative audit log.

post.description: Authenticates admin credential and issues a Sanctum token.
Revokes the current authenticated token.

get.description: Retrieves current admin profile details.

put.description: Updates profile fields of the authenticated admin.
Changes the password of the authenticated admin.

get.description: Retrieves a list of all uploaded driver documents currently pending verification.

200.description: List of pending documents retrieved successfully.

post.description: Approves or rejects a driver onboarding document. Rejection requires a reason.

parameters.name: document
parameters.description: The ID of the driver document to verify.

200.description: Document has been approved or rejected successfully.

get.description: Retrieves complete metrics summaries and chart data arrays for operations.
Retrieves a list of all registered drivers, supporting sorting, searching, pagination, and status filters.
Retrieves a single driver user's profile, vehicles, wallet, and devices details.

put.description: Allows editing a driver's name or email address.

post.description: Marks onboarding driver status as active and approves all their pending documents.
Resets driver status to pending and rejects pending documents with a reason.
Suspends the driver user account.
Unsuspends the driver user account, restoring access.

get.description: Retrieves all onboarding documents uploaded by this driver.

post.description: Queues a system-wide push and database notification broadcast to selected targets.

get.description: Retrieves all promo codes config settings.

post.description: Registers a new promo code with usability limits, expiry, and discounts.

get.description: Retrieves details of a single promo code setup.

put.description: Updates attributes of an existing promo code.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a promo code config.

get.description: Retrieves all reviews, supporting filters for rating, review type (rider/driver), and keyword search.
Retrieves details of a specific ride review.

delete.description: Soft deletes a review from public visibility.

get.description: Retrieves a list of all rides, supporting search, sorting, pagination, and status filters.
Retrieves a single ride's details including rider, driver, payment, and review records.

post.description: Cancels an active ride from administrative dashboard control.
Reverses the ride fare transaction, crediting rider wallet and debiting driver wallet.

get.description: Retrieves history logs of all status transitions for this ride.
Retrieves a list of all registered riders, supporting sorting, searching, pagination, and status filters.
Retrieves a single rider's profile, including their wallet and device registries.

put.description: Allows editing a rider's name or email address.

delete.description: Soft deletes the rider user account.

post.description: Suspends the rider user account.
Unsuspends the rider user account, restoring access.

get.description: Retrieves all database-driven platform configurations.

put.description: Saves platform configuration values, clearing and updating the cache.

post.description: Manually refreshes/invalidates system settings caching layer.

get.description: Retrieves a list of all user wallets, supporting sorting, searching, and pagination.
Retrieves details of a user's wallet by its ID.

post.description: Credits funds manually to a user's wallet with auditing.
Debits funds manually from a user's wallet with auditing. Validates balance.

get.description: Retrieves ledger logs of all wallet balance adjustments across the platform.
Retrieves all withdrawal requests, supporting pagination, status, and sorting filters.
Retrieves details of a specific withdrawal request.

post.description: Approves a pending withdrawal request, completing the wallet debit action.
Rejects a pending withdrawal request with a descriptive note.
Authenticates a user using phone and password. Returns user profile details and access token.
Revokes the authenticated user's current Sanctum access token.
Requests a 6-digit password reset OTP code. Sends the code to the user's email.
Verifies the 6-digit OTP code and updates the user's password. Revokes all active tokens.

otp.description: The 6-digit OTP code received via email.

get.description: Returns the profile details of the authenticated Rider or Driver user.

put.description: Updates the profile information or notification settings for the authenticated user.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the authenticated user's account. Performs cleanup of related data.

password.description: The user's current password for confirmation.

post.description: Revokes the user's current Sanctum access token and issues a new one with the same role ability.
Registers a new driver user, creates driver profile, vehicle details, and wallet. Automatically logs them in, returning bearer token. Account is pending documents approval.

201.description: Driver registered successfully. Account is pending documents approval.

message.example: Driver registered successfully. Account is pending documents approval.

post.description: Registers a new rider user, creates an automatic wallet, logs them in and returns a bearer token.
Generates and sends a 6-digit OTP code to the user's phone number for login or registration.

200.description: OTP code generated and sent successfully.

post.description: Verifies the 6-digit OTP code sent to the user's phone number.
Creates a new chat conversation thread for an active ride or returns the existing one.

403.description: Forbidden access to the ride conversation.

get.description: Retrieves all messages for a specific conversation thread.

post.description: Sends a chat message to a conversation thread.

message.example: Hello, I am at the pickup point.

post.description: Updates a message status to delivered and broadcasts the delivered state event.

403.description: Forbidden access to update this message status.

post.description: Updates a message status to read and broadcasts the read state event.

403.description: Forbidden access to update this message status.

post.description: Broadcasts a client typing started event on the private ride channel.

403.description: Forbidden access to this ride conversation.

post.description: Broadcasts a client typing stopped event on the private ride channel.

403.description: Forbidden access to this ride conversation.

post.description: Registers or updates a user's device token for FCM push notifications.

put.description: Updates parameters of a previously registered device token.

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: The ID of the user device.

delete.description: Deletes and deregisters a device token from receiving push notifications.

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: The ID of the user device.

post.description: Uploads or re-uploads a driver onboarding document (driving_license, vehicle_registration, or insurance). Requires multipart/form-data payload.

get.description: Returns the overall driver status, vehicle approval status, bank account linking status, checklist requirements status, and list of uploaded documents.
Retrieves the linked bank account details for the authenticated driver.

404.description: Driver profile or bank account details not found.

post.description: Links a new bank account or updates the existing bank account for the authenticated driver.
Enables an active, verified driver to toggle their availability online or offline.

403.description: Only active approved drivers can go online.

message.example: Only active approved drivers can go online.

post.description: Updates the live location coordinates (latitude, longitude, bearing) for the authenticated driver. Synchronizes with Redis if the driver is online.

get.description: Retrieves driver dashboard details including profile summary, ratings, online status, and completed rides.
Retrieves the details of a ride. Only accessible by the assigned driver.

post.description: Transition the ride status from accepted to arriving. Accessible only to the assigned driver.
Transition the ride status from arriving to arrived. Sets the arrived_at timestamp. Accessible only to the assigned driver.
Transition the ride status from arrived to in_progress. Verifies the rider's 6-digit OTP. Sets started_at and otp_verified_at. Accessible only to the assigned driver.

otp.description: The 6-digit OTP provided by the rider.

post.description: Transition the ride status from in_progress to completed. Computes actual fare and stores actual trip metrics and fare breakdown. Accessible only to the assigned driver.

get.description: Retrieve a list of active, pending ride requests offered to the authenticated driver.

post.description: Accept a pending ride request. Assigns the driver and locks the ride to prevent race conditions.

422.description: Ride request is no longer available.

message.example: Ride request is no longer available.

post.description: Decline a pending ride request.

get.description: Retrieve the current active, non-completed, non-cancelled ride assigned to the authenticated driver.
Streams the driver document directly to the browser (inline) for previewing.

parameters.name: document
parameters.description: The ID of the driver document.

404.description: Document or physical file not found.

get.description: Initiates a file download for the requested driver document.

parameters.name: document
parameters.description: The ID of the driver document.

404.description: Document or physical file not found.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of notifications for the authenticated user, supporting filters and sorting.
Retrieves count of unread notifications for the user.
Retrieves details of a specific notification log.

parameters.name: notification
parameters.description: The ID of the notification log.

parameters.name: notification
parameters.description: The ID of the notification log.

post.description: Marks a specific notification log as read.

parameters.name: notification
parameters.description: The ID of the notification log.

post.description: Marks all notifications of the user as read.
Restores a soft-deleted notification log.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the soft-deleted notification log.

get.description: Retrieves payment information for a specific ride. Access is restricted to the rider or driver of the ride.
Retrieves payment history logs. For Riders, returns rides they paid for. For Drivers, returns their earnings and commission logs.
Generates a structured receipt/invoice breakdown for a completed ride.
Retrieves reviews (rider-to-driver and driver-to-rider) associated with a ride. Restricted to the ride participants.

message.example: You are not authorized to view reviews for this ride.

post.description: Submits a rating (1-5 stars) and optional review text for a completed ride. Only participants of the ride (rider or driver) can review it once.

422.description: Validation failed (e.g. invalid rating or duplicate submission).

403.description: Forbidden. User is not a participant of this ride or user is soft deleted.

message.example: You are not authorized to review this ride.

get.description: Retrieves public review history for a specific driver user.

parameters.name: driver
parameters.description: The User ID of the driver.

get.description: Retrieves review history for a specific rider user.

parameters.name: rider
parameters.description: The User ID of the rider.

post.description: Get fare estimates for all active vehicle types between pickup and destination.
Create a new ride request and find nearby drivers.
Cancel an active ride request. Allowed only before trip starts (statuses: pending, accepted, arriving, arrived).

get.description: Get details of a specific ride by ID.
Retrieve a list of past and active rides requested by the authenticated rider.
Get the current active (non-completed and non-cancelled) ride for the rider.
Retrieves current driver coordinates, heading, speed, and calculated ETA metrics for an active ride.

403.description: Forbidden access to track this ride.

get.description: Retrieves current wallet balance, currency, and the last transaction details.
Retrieves a paginated, sortable list of ledger transactions for the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a Stripe PaymentIntent for topping up the user's wallet balance.
Requests withdrawal of wallet balance earnings.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of withdrawal requests filed by the authenticated user.
Retrieves details of a specific withdrawal request.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the withdrawal request.

post.description: Idempotently consumes PaymentIntent event callbacks to settle user top-up wallets.

UnauthorizedResponse.description: Bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired.

ForbiddenResponse.description: The user does not have the required role or token abilities.

NotFoundResponse.description: The requested resource could not be found.

bearerAuth.description: Use Sanctum Bearer token for authorized requests (e.g. Bearer 1|...)
